name: SM_Window_Stained_Twin_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: two-light stained-glass window, 1.3 m wide and 2.6 m to the point: blue and green ground, red and amber figures, lead cames and saddle bars, stone surround with a mullion
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: The figures are abstract: an oval of robe colours with a pale disc for a face in each light, not drawn saints. No tracery above the mullion. The glass is opaque: colour, lead and saddle bars are baked onto a flat pane, so it does not transmit light or throw colour (a translucent or emissive material is engine work). The surround is bevelled 12-triangle blocks with open joints.
